note: A short, Trump-heavy week: Jon Stewart spent Monday on Xi Jinping's White House visit, and Kimmel's show, taping at the Brooklyn Academy of Music, coined a new nickname after Trump appeared to nod off at an Oval Office event. I couldn't find reliably dated, quotable monologue lines from Meyers or Fallon for this stretch, so they're left out rather than guessed at.
